VEIPUS OPAL Skittles is a pod-only replacement for a compatible VEIPUS OPAL device, built for users who love colourful, candy-forward flavours that stay bright and sweet. This pod is engineered for easy daily use: a visible juice body helps you track remaining liquid, while a Dual Mesh coil supports smooth heating and stable flavour delivery. With adjustable airflow, you can tune the draw to make the candy notes feel richer or lighter depending on your preference.

Skittles Flavour Profile
Skittles-style flavour is a mixed fruit candy blend with a lively, sugary opening and a layered mid-draw that hints at multiple fruit notes at once. Instead of tasting like a single fruit, it delivers a “rainbow candy” effect—sweet, bright, and playful—then finishes clean so it doesn’t feel overly sticky on the palate. If you enjoy bold sweetness and a fun, dessert-style taste, this pod is made to keep that candy profile consistent and satisfying.

Dial In Your Candy Intensity
Airflow adjustment makes a real difference with candy blends:

Small airflow: tighter draw, stronger candy punch
Medium airflow: balanced sweetness for daily use
Large airflow: more open draw, lighter and smoother feel
For most users, medium is the easiest starting point, then adjust after a few pulls to match your comfort level.

Dual Mesh Coil + Visible Juice Benefits
The Dual Mesh coil design aims to keep flavour output smooth and even, helping candy notes stay bright without becoming harsh. The visible juice design reduces guesswork, especially if you rotate pods or keep a backup ready for travel.

name: RELX Infinity Device – Sky Blush (Limited Edition)
description:
The newest addition to the RELX line up! With its innovative leak-resistant maze coil and SmartPace Vibration technology, introducing the RELX Infinity Vape Pod Device Kit! The RELX Infinity is jam packed with various features from its dual charging system and sleek ergonomic design.

 

What sets the RELX Infinity apart? The Infinity optimizes the activation draw to be set at the perfect temperature providing you with rich vapor production and excellent flavor. The device features haptic vibration feedback when you insert the pre-filled pod.

 

Hate leaky pods? RELX Infinity pods are leak resistant due to its new maze coil design. The coil features 11 structural layers that prevent internal leaks and condensation for a more secure vaping experience.

 

The Infinity supports the new RELX Infinity Portable Charging Cases offering up to 2 and a half extra days of charge with it’s 1000maH of battery life. Charging case sold separately.

 

The battery features 380mAH for long lasting everyday usage and a massive 1.9mL capacity for its pre-filled nicotine salt e-juice pods that lasts approximately 650 puffs. RELX Infinity pods come in a wide range of flavors to choose from.

name: Zeus Bolt 2 Grinder
description:
Zeus Bolt 2 Grinder

The Zeus Bolt 2 Grinder is a small but mighty grinder. It is small enough that it remains discreet and portable if needed, yet it promises the perfect grind thanks to its exceptionally high-quality Aircraft Grade Anodized Aluminum (AGAA) teeth. It is the perfect grinder for avid vapers and enthusiasts.

The ZEUS Bolt Grinder is a medium-sized grinder that features diamond-cut teeth that are calibrated to grind herbs to the perfect consistency. Grind consistency is extra important when using vaporizers, as it will enhance efficient vaporization and therefore save money over the long term.

Unlike many other four-piece aluminum grinders, the ZEUS Bolt 2 Grinder comes with an extremely hard, durable case that is air-tight, making it the perfect smell-proof container for your Bolt 2 on the go. It is also convertible into a three-piece grinder by simply leaving the screening compartment out.

The ZEUS Bolt 2 is the perfect grinder no matter what vaporizer you may have! Order yours today.

 
Package Contents

  •    1 x 4 piece ZEUS Bolt 2 Grinder
  •    1 x Air-tight carrying case
  •    1 x ZEUS scoop

How To Use

  • Open top of the grinder
  • Place herb on the bottom layer of teeth
  • Close top of the grinder
  • Rotate top section of grinder, by twisting back and forth
  • When herb has been ground to the perfect consistency for vaporization, it will fall through to the second layer and into the middle chamber
  • Unscrew the top two pieces from the bottom two in order to access herb located in the middle chamber
  • The bottom compartment stores botanical dust which falls through the fine mesh screen

Cleaning

  • Empty contents of grinder from the middle compartment and bottom compartment
  • Disassemble grinder into 4 pieces
  • Soak 4 pieces in 99% alcohol for about 30 minutes
  • Remove pieces from alcohol
  • Use ZEUS Bristle Pipe Cleaners to dislodge any remaining particles or residue
  • Rinse pieces with hot water
  • Drip or towel dry all pieces completely before re-assembling
  • Reassemble your sparkling clean ZEUS Bolt 2 grinder!

name: Zeus Bolt 2 Grinder
description:
Zeus Bolt 2 Grinder

The Zeus Bolt 2 Grinder is a small but mighty grinder. It is small enough that it remains discreet and portable if needed, yet it promises the perfect grind thanks to its exceptionally high-quality Aircraft Grade Anodized Aluminum (AGAA) teeth. It is the perfect grinder for avid vapers and enthusiasts.

Unlike many other four-piece aluminum grinders, the ZEUS Bolt 2 Grinder comes with an extremely hard, durable case that is air-tight, making it the perfect smell-proof container for your Bolt 2 on the go. It is also convertible into a three-piece grinder by simply leaving the screening compartment out.

The ZEUS Bolt 2 is the perfect grinder no matter what vaporizer you may have! Order yours today.

 
Package Contents

  •    1 x 4 piece ZEUS Bolt 2 Grinder
  •    1 x Air-tight carrying case
  •    1 x ZEUS scoop

How To Use

  • Open top of the grinder
  • Place herb on the bottom layer of teeth
  • Close top of the grinder
  • Rotate top section of grinder, by twisting back and forth
  • When herb has been ground to the perfect consistency for vaporization, it will fall through to the second layer and into the middle chamber
  • Unscrew the top two pieces from the bottom two in order to access herb located in the middle chamber
  • The bottom compartment stores botanical dust which falls through the fine mesh screen

Cleaning

  • Empty contents of grinder from the middle compartment and bottom compartment
  • Disassemble grinder into 4 pieces
  • Soak 4 pieces in 99% alcohol for about 30 minutes
  • Remove pieces from alcohol
  • Use ZEUS Bristle Pipe Cleaners to dislodge any remaining particles or residue
  • Rinse pieces with hot water
  • Drip or towel dry all pieces completely before re-assembling
  • Reassemble your sparkling clean ZEUS Bolt 2 grinder!

The multi-tool provides the option to choose between hot and cold loading with their concentrates. Hot loading is as simple as it sounds; load your wax into the device once the chamber has fully heated up and the LEDs indicate it’s time to start your session. name: Tronian Gammatron Kanthal Heating Element
description:
The Kanthal Heating Element Pack features substitutes for broken or overused accessories, included with the Tronian Gammatron device.

This Element pack consists of two spring-wound glass kanthal coils, three heating element o-rings, and three base device o-rings. Rolling the coil into a spring before winding it around the glass is essential to increase the distance of the coil packed into the heating element. This ensures that the heat emanates more evenly and much faster, allowing a session to capture all active ingredients in one inhale rather than having them separated by a weak coil too slow to heat up for an element to be effective.

For users frequently using their Gammatron, ensure this pack is ready for future replacements. Replacing used parts will allow you to get the most out of the Tronian Gammatron and truly enjoy the most convenient wax pen on the market.

name: Zeus Grime Cleaning Sticks – 20 Pack
description:
ZEUS Grime Sticks are cotton swabs that are filled with ethyl alcohol that can be used to clean various vaporizer components, most notably, heating chambers. Use with any vaporizer component that can be cleaned with ethyl alcohol (metal, glass and ceramic). Regularly cleaning your vaporizer components helps maintain high-quality and fresh vapor, so anyone with a vaporizer can benefit from keeping a pack of these on hand.

Ethyl alcohol differs from traditionally used isopropyl alcohol as it is the same type of alcohol contained in alcoholic beverages. This means that it is much safer for use as a cleaner than isopropyl alcohol and works just as effectively. ZEUS Grime sticks are unique and easy to use as they feature a quick snap top that releases the ethyl alcohol into one durable cotton end, making cleaning very easy and mess free.

Includes:
20 x Grime Sticks

How to Use
– Remove ZEUS Grime Stick from package.
– Snap top of Grime Stick on the indicated line.
– Let the alcohol drain to the swab’s other end.
– Use the alcohol-moistened end to clean the metal, glass or ceramic component of your vaporizer.
– Discard Grime Stick.
– Rinse external vaporizer component or heat up the vaporizer to remove excess ethyl alcohol particles in chamber.

With each inhale, experience a harmonious blend that invigorates your senses and brings a delightful freshness that lingers!

description: MIDNIGHT BERRY CHILL is an enchanting nocturnal escape, where the allure of twilight meets ripe, luscious berries in a symphony of flavour with wild blueberries, raspberries, and blackberries entwined together. Each inhale brings a cool, refreshing wave, sweet and slightly tart, awakening your senses like a gentle breeze on a summer night. This flavour evokes the magic of starry skies, late-night adventures, and whispered secrets in the dark.

name: Zeus Bolt 2 Grinder
description:
Zeus Bolt 2 Grinder

The Zeus Bolt 2 Grinder is a small but mighty grinder. It is small enough that it remains discreet and portable if needed, yet it promises the perfect grind thanks to its exceptionally high-quality Aircraft Grade Anodized Aluminum (AGAA) teeth. It is the perfect grinder for avid vapers and enthusiasts.

The ZEUS Bolt Grinder is a medium-sized grinder that features diamond-cut teeth that are calibrated to grind herbs to the perfect consistency. Grind consistency is extra important when using vaporizers, as it will enhance efficient vaporization and therefore save money over the long term.

Unlike many other four-piece aluminum grinders, the ZEUS Bolt 2 Grinder comes with an extremely hard, durable case that is air-tight, making it the perfect smell-proof container for your Bolt 2 on the go. It is also convertible into a three-piece grinder by simply leaving the screening compartment out.

The ZEUS Bolt 2 is the perfect grinder no matter what vaporizer you may have! Order yours today.

 
Package Contents

  •    1 x 4 piece ZEUS Bolt 2 Grinder
  •    1 x Air-tight carrying case
  •    1 x ZEUS scoop

How To Use

  • Open top of the grinder
  • Place herb on the bottom layer of teeth
  • Close top of the grinder
  • Rotate top section of grinder, by twisting back and forth
  • When herb has been ground to the perfect consistency for vaporization, it will fall through to the second layer and into the middle chamber
  • Unscrew the top two pieces from the bottom two in order to access herb located in the middle chamber
  • The bottom compartment stores botanical dust which falls through the fine mesh screen

Cleaning

  • Empty contents of grinder from the middle compartment and bottom compartment
  • Disassemble grinder into 4 pieces
  • Soak 4 pieces in 99% alcohol for about 30 minutes
  • Remove pieces from alcohol
  • Use ZEUS Bristle Pipe Cleaners to dislodge any remaining particles or residue
  • Rinse pieces with hot water
  • Drip or towel dry all pieces completely before re-assembling
  • Reassemble your sparkling clean ZEUS Bolt 2 grinder!

name: Utillian 8 eRig Multi-Tool
description:
Utillian eliminated the need to buy separate parts by creating this multi-operational tool, which can be used as a choke, dab tool, and carb cap. One of the biggest pain points that the multi-tool eliminates is that it prevents leaving wax marks on the surfaces where you operate your e rig. This advantage makes the user experience with the U8 e rig hassle-free, allowing users to spend more time enjoying the sessions instead of cleaning.

The multi-tool provides the option to choose between hot and cold loading with their concentrates. Hot loading is as simple as it sounds; load your wax into the device once the chamber has fully heated up and the LEDs indicate it’s time to start your session. This method is better suited for those who want to fully extract every bit of flavor from their wax. On the other hand, the method known as cold loading does not produce the same quality vapor but is much more convenient. This method is done by scooping up your wax with the multi-tool and putting it back on the device while cold. Once the device has turned on, the wax will slowly drip off of the tool, so you don’t need to waste time setting your wax directly into the chamber.

The multi-tool is a revolutionary accessory not seen on any other e rig, which adds to the user-friendliness and convenience of this device.

description:

description: The Tronian Milatron mouthpiece is made out of temperature safe plastic, and features a ceramic filter to avoid the vapor’s flavour from being negatively impacted as compared to plastic vapor pathways. name: Tronian Gammatron Kanthal Heating Element
description:
The Kanthal Heating Element Pack features substitutes for broken or overused accessories, included with the Tronian Gammatron device.

This Element pack consists of two spring-wound glass kanthal coils, three heating element o-rings, and three base device o-rings. Rolling the coil into a spring before winding it around the glass is essential to increase the distance of the coil packed into the heating element. This ensures that the heat emanates more evenly and much faster, allowing a session to capture all active ingredients in one inhale rather than having them separated by a weak coil too slow to heat up for an element to be effective.

For users frequently using their Gammatron, ensure this pack is ready for future replacements. Replacing used parts will allow you to get the most out of the Tronian Gammatron and truly enjoy the most convenient wax pen on the market.

name: Zeus Grime Cleaning Sticks – 20 Pack
description:
ZEUS Grime Sticks are cotton swabs that are filled with ethyl alcohol that can be used to clean various vaporizer components, most notably, heating chambers. Use with any vaporizer component that can be cleaned with ethyl alcohol (metal, glass and ceramic). Regularly cleaning your vaporizer components helps maintain high-quality and fresh vapor, so anyone with a vaporizer can benefit from keeping a pack of these on hand.

Ethyl alcohol differs from traditionally used isopropyl alcohol as it is the same type of alcohol contained in alcoholic beverages. This means that it is much safer for use as a cleaner than isopropyl alcohol and works just as effectively. ZEUS Grime sticks are unique and easy to use as they feature a quick snap top that releases the ethyl alcohol into one durable cotton end, making cleaning very easy and mess free.

Includes:
20 x Grime Sticks

How to Use
– Remove ZEUS Grime Stick from package.
– Snap top of Grime Stick on the indicated line.
– Let the alcohol drain to the swab’s other end.
– Use the alcohol-moistened end to clean the metal, glass or ceramic component of your vaporizer.
– Discard Grime Stick.
– Rinse external vaporizer component or heat up the vaporizer to remove excess ethyl alcohol particles in chamber.

name: EASY-PEASY STRAWBERRY – VAPEHUB ULTRA 20000
description: EASY-PEASY STRAWBERRY is a delightful journey into a sun-drenched strawberry field, where the sweet aroma of freshly picked strawberries fills the air. This flavour bursts with juicy, sun-ripened strawberries, perfectly balanced with a touch of creamy goodness that makes every puff feel like a sweet indulgence. It’s like savoring a luscious strawberry shortcake on a warm day, leaving you with a smile and a sense of pure bliss!

name: FROSTED BLACKBERRY CRUSH – VAPEHUB ULTRA 20000
description: FROSTED BLACKBERRY CRUSH is a captivating experience that transports you to a cool, enchanted forest where wild blackberries grow in abundance. Picture the moment you bite into a plump, juicy blackberry, its rich, tangy flavour cascading over your taste buds, perfectly complemented by a frosty chill that refreshes with every inhale. This flavour blends the deep sweetness of sun-ripened blackberries with a delightful icy twist, creating an exhilarating sensation that awakens your senses.

name: MEXI MANGO MADNESS – VAPEHUB ULTRA 20000
description: MEXI MANGO MADNESS is a vibrant fiesta for your senses, capturing the essence of sun-drenched mangoes straight from the heart of Mexico. A ripe, succulent mango, its golden flesh dripping with sweetness, creating a perfect balance of tartness and juiciness that dances on your tongue. Each puff is a celebration of summer, filled with the warm breezes of tropical evenings and the sounds of lively mariachis.

name: VELVET GRAPE – VAPEHUB ULTRA 20000
description: VELVET GRAPE is an indulgent embrace of succulent grapes, smooth and rich as luxurious velvet over your senses. Picture a sunlit vineyard, where plump, juicy grapes burst with flavour, releasing a symphony of sweetness and tartness. Each sip is like biting into the ripest fruit, creating a silky mouthfeel that lingers. This flavour celebrates nature’s bounty, evoking memories of laughter-filled picnics.

name: 20700/21700 SINGLE Battery Silicon Case
description: A battery is only as good as it’s protection! These silicone battery cases support both 20700 & 21700 batteries to ensure you are always carrying a battery that is safe and secure.

name: Vuber Pulse 510 Smart Battery
description:
The PULSE battery is the sleekest and smartest 510 thread battery on the market

VUBER PULSE TOUCH AND VUBER PULSE DROP ALSO AVAILABLE

The PULSE is a one-of-a-kind patented smart battery that reads the resistance of the cartridge and automatically adjusts the settings for optimal use – simply attach your cartridge and start vaping! The Pulse enhances the flavor profile, increases the size of the hit, and regulates the temperature to prevent the user from burning the cartridge out. It also features Vuber’s patented “Never Burn” technology, which tapers the heat as you draw, assuring that the user gets the best tasting hit every single time. The Pulse has an OLED screen that shows battery life, resistance, voltage, and wattage. As an added bonus, The Pulse can be used while charging assuring no delay in the user vaping experience!

For users that want more control, the Pulse can also be put into “manual” mode – select from 4 preset voltages (2.8, 3.2, 3.4, or 3.7 volts) to dial in the desired temperature. The Pulse’s “Never Burn” technology will work to taper down the voltage as you hit, giving you a truly unique experience for your cartridges!

RECOMMENDED USE:
All 510 Thread Concentrate Cartridges

Product Measurements: 4.4 inches tall x 0.67 inches wide x 0.67 inches thick.
Product Weight: 1.4 oz (Pulse only)

description:

The TinyMight 2 Vaporizer is the perfect device for anyone looking for a stylish, powerful and portable vaping experience. This convection vaporizer combines beauty with robustness, showing off a sleek finish made from solid American walnut and stainless steel. This gorgeous design makes the Tinymight 2 easy to flaunt and carry. It also features an intuitive user interface making it simple to use, even for beginners.

Fuelled by a powerful 18650 battery, lasting up to two hours of continuous use, the Tinymight 2 can be recharged quickly with the included USB-C cable. It also features a variable analogue temperature control system. This system allows you to adjust the heat level exactly where you want for your desired vaping experience. The device also has an adjustable airflow system that lets you customize the amount of vapor produced. The quality of the Tinymight 2 vaporizer will please even the most experienced vapers.

THE TINYMIGHT 2 VAPORIZER FEATURES:

  • New Updated 2024 Version
  • Convection heating
  • Small Portable Vape
  • Adjustable herb chamber
  • Extremely quick heat up time from 3 seconds!
  • In-Built Multiool for stirring, tamping and emptying the bowl.
  • Wide precision-controlled temperature range (140°C-250°C)
  • Fast USB-C Port charging
  • Replaceable 18650 battery
  • High quality materials: Walnut wood base, stainless steel, aluminium, quartz glass tube.
  • Duel-Cylinder Vapor cooling unit
  • Dual modes: On demand, and session mode
  • Stealth mode: lights turn off
  • Eco-friendly packaging
  • 10 Year Warranty

HERE’S WHY THE TINYMIGHT 2 STANDS OUT:

The Tinymight 2 is powerful, yet maintains full flavour and terpenes. This compact and gorgeous full-convection vaporizer provides ultra-fast heating in 3-5 seconds. It can produce vapor on-demand instantly, or more precisely through session mode.

The first mode is On Demand: Users can take quick single draws from the Tinymight 2 without having to wait for the device to fully heat up. This makes it more than ideal for those who want to get the most out of their vaping experience in the shortest amount of time.

The second mode is Session Mode: This allows users to take multiple draws from the Tinymight 2 over a longer period of time at a custom temperature. This mode is perfect for those who want to enjoy their vaping experience for an extended period of time without having to constantly reload the device.

The Tinymight 2 Vaporizer also features an included Multi-Tool which can be used to mix, tamp and empty the bowl as well as check the battery life of the device. With adjustable temperature and airflow settings, the Tinymight 2 has it all.

 

We have tested many portable dry herb vapes, but the Tinymight 2 stands apart from the rest with its amazing build quality, strong hits and great flavour. It is even comparable to that of the trusty Mighty+.

ABOUT THE TINYMIGHT VAPORIZER:

Built and assembled in Finland Since 2019, the Tinymight vaporizer brand has grown in popularity due to its high surface area heater and convection technology for efficient extraction.

The Tinymight has a traditional design, featuring adjustable temperature as well as power output settings, which are both enabled by its chipset. To adjust the temp, simply turn the dial on the device’s bottom between position 1 (140°C) and position 10 (230°C/250°C session mode / on demand mode)

TINYMIGHT 2 IMPROVEMENTS

The vapor created by both is practically the same, with the Tinymight 2 having better performance when harder hits are taken.

The most obvious difference is in their respective battery doors. The original Tinymight has a hard-to-remove cap which needed a coin to remove. Whereas the Tinymight 2’s door is prominent and can easily twist off by hand.

The new Tinymight 2 vape has a much nicer American walnut wood finish than the old Tinymight’s oak wood design. This difference is both functional and aesthetic, as walnut has better heat insulation properties as well as a smoother hand feel. Additionally, it also features internal Fast-speed USB-C Charging, which is a huge benefit.

The battery level is now indicated through vibrations and coloured lights on the back of the device and the front of the in-built multi-tool. This provides a better understanding of charge level so you can plan accordingly.

Overall, the Tinymight 2 has tighter manufacturing tolerances, a healthier weight, easier temperature adjustment and battery removal. The buttons feel much more robust and tactile, and the walnut wood really makes all the difference compared to its predecessor.

HOW DO I USE TINYMIGHT 2 AND GET AMAZING VAPOR QUALITY?

Using the Tinymight 2 vaporizer is easy and straightforward. To get the best vapor quality, it is important to follow a few simple steps:

First, make sure that your device is fully charged before use. This will ensure that you have enough power to produce thick clouds of vapor.

Next, grind your herbs into a fine consistency using a grinder or mortar and pestle. This will help to ensure that the herbs are evenly heated and vaporized.

Once your herbs are ready, fill the herb chamber with your desired amount of material. Make sure not to overfill it as this can lead to clogging and poor airflow. Use the included multi-tool to stir and tamp.

Finally, adjust the temperature settings on the bottom of the device to your desired level. The Tinymight 2 has a wide range of temperatures from 140°C to 250°C, so you can find the perfect setting for your herbs.

Once you have set the temperature, press and hold the power button for a few seconds to begin heating. The device will vibrate when it is ready to use within 3-5s.

Now all that’s left is to enjoy your vaping session!

IN CONCLUSION, WE HIGHLY RECOMMEND THE TINYMIGHT 2 VAPORIZER.

The Tinymight 2 is a great choice for those looking for a portable vaporizer that can handle both dry herbs and concentrates. With improved quality over its predecessor in all departments, the Tinymight 2 is a gorgeous and sleek device you’ll be happy to show off.

With 10 adjustable temperature settings you can find the perfect temperature for your material. The battery life is also great, the removable batteries lasting up to two hours on a single charge.

The Tinymight 2 is well-built, a great session vape, and easy to use. It heats up very quickly and produces great tasting vapor. It’s a great choice for those who want a high-quality, portable vaporizer in a classy shell.

name: Banana Taffy Freeze – Foger Bit 35K Puffs
description:
Foger Bit 35K – Futuristic Design, Legendary Performance, 35,000 Puff Power

The Foger Bit 35K isn’t just another disposable — it’s a bold leap forward in smart vape design. With its Bitcoin-inspired body, transparent tank, and curved OLED display, this powerful 35,000 puff device delivers sleek visuals, satisfying performance, and long-lasting flavor.

Powered by an 850mAh rechargeable battery and featuring dual mesh coils, the Bit 35K offers two modes: Norm (up to 35,000 puffs) and Boost (up to 25,000 puffs) — all controlled with a press of a button. Combine that with USB-C fast charging, adjustable airflow, and a glowing chip animation, and you’ve got one of the smartest disposables on the market.

Why Choose the Foger Bit 35K?

  • Transparent Tank: Easily monitor e-liquid levels through a fully visible chamber.
  • Curved OLED Display: Live updates on puff count, battery life, and mode setting.
  • Bitcoin-Inspired Design: Metallic styling with animated chipboard glow for a futuristic feel.
  • Dual Wattage Modes: Switch between Norm (longer life) and Boost (stronger vapor) modes.
  • Dual Mesh Coils: Smooth, flavorful vapor from start to finish.
  • Adjustable Airflow: Customize each inhale to match your draw preference.
  • USB-C Fast Charging: Recharge in ~30 minutes with built-in overcharge protection.

Specifications and Features

  • Dimensions: 98.8 × 52 × 30.5 mm
  • Battery Capacity: 850 mAh rechargeable with Type‑C fast charging
  • Puff Count: Up to 35,000 puffs (Norm Mode), 25,000 puffs (Boost Mode)
  • Coil Type: 0.8 Ω Dual Mesh Coil
  • Nicotine Strength: 50 mg/mL (5%)
  • Safety Features: Overcharge & short‑circuit protection
  • Operation: Draw-activated with Boost Mode button

J cartridges: simplicity for your vape

Geekvape is making life easier for vapers with J cartridges. These little marvels come with built-in coils for no-fuss use. And when the coil reaches the end of its life, there’s no need to get your fingers dirty: just replace the entire cartridge and start smoking again. It’s as easy as 1-2-3!

Sold in pairs.

J Series built-in coils: choose your style

J cartridges feature built-in coils optimised for intense flavours thanks to their mesh construction. Here are the different options available to help you find what you’re looking for:

  • Cartridge J 0.3 ohm: RDL draw – 32W to 38W – PG/VG ratios from 40/60 to 30/70 – Recommended nicotine levels up to 6 mg/ml.
  • Cartridge J 0.4 ohm: RDL draw – 23W to 28W – PG/VG ratios from 50/50 to 30/70 – Recommended nicotine levels up to 6 mg/ml.
  • Cartridge J 0.6 ohm: RDL draw – 16W to 21W – ratios PG/VG from 50/50 to 40/60 – recommended nicotine levels up to 12 mg/ml.
  • Cartridge J 0.8 ohm: MTL draw – 12W to 17W – ratios PG/VG from 60/40 to 40/60 – recommended nicotine levels up to 20 mg/ml.
  • Cartridge J 1.2 ohm: MTL draw – 8W to 12W – PG/VG ratios from 70/30 to 50/50 – Recommended nicotine levels up to 20 mg/ml.

Using J cartridges: express guide

1. Easy filling

  • No need to remove the cartridge from the battery.
  • Open the silicone tab on the side.
  • Pour in your e-liquid.
  • Close the tab carefully.

2. Replacing the cartridge

  • Unclip the old cartridge from your pod.
  • Replace it with a new cartridge J.
  • Tip: if the coil is new, let it soak in e-liquid for 10 minutes before vaping. If you notice a reduction in flavour or a burnt taste, it’s time to replace your cartridge.

short_description: VEIPUS OPAL Device (Golden) – Device Only features a powerful 1100mAh battery, adjustable 22W/26W/28W output, and a sleek hidden screen showing battery and wattage. Compact, easy button control with light bar and child-proof design. Pods sold separately.
description:
VEIPUS OPAL Device (Golden) – 1100mAh Battery, Adjustable 22W/26W/28W (Device Only)
VEIPUS OPAL (Golden) is a premium-looking pod device designed for users who want a dependable battery, simple button control, and a clean, modern finish that stands out. This listing is for the device only—pods are sold separately—so you can pair OPAL with your preferred compatible pods and switch flavours whenever you like. With its compact build, discreet hidden screen, and three power options, OPAL is built for everyday convenience without turning your routine into a complicated setup.

Golden Finish, Everyday Practicality
The Golden edition brings a refined, metallic style while keeping OPAL’s core strengths: portability, clarity, and quick control. The body is sized for pocket carry and comfortable grip, making it easy to bring to work, keep in the car, or carry on day-to-day errands. The overall design stays minimal, but the gold tone adds a premium touch—ideal for users who prefer a device that looks polished while remaining practical.

1100mAh Battery for Confident Daily Use
At the center of the OPAL device is a 1100mAh battery, built to support extended daily use for most users. A larger battery means fewer interruptions and less time worrying about power management. Whether you take short pulls throughout the day or prefer longer sessions, OPAL is designed to deliver stable output and dependable runtime. The hidden screen helps you keep track of battery status at a glance, so you can plan ahead instead of getting caught off guard.

Adjustable Output: 22W / 26W / 28W
Not every pod performs best at the same power level. That’s why VEIPUS OPAL includes three selectable wattage settings—22W, 26W, and 28W. Lower wattage is a great choice for a cooler, smoother feel, while higher wattage can provide a warmer, more pronounced delivery. This quick adjustment is especially useful if you rotate different pod flavours or simply want the ability to fine-tune intensity without complex menus.

Hidden Screen + Light Bar: Clear Info Without the Clutter
OPAL’s hidden screen shows the essential information you actually need—such as battery level and selected wattage—while keeping the device visually clean when the display isn’t in use. A simple light bar adds an extra layer of quick status visibility, which is helpful when you’re on the move and want instant feedback without digging through settings.

Simple Button Controls
Adjust wattage: Press the button to cycle 22W → 26W → 28W.
Light bar on/off: Press and hold for 3 seconds.
Device on/off: Press 5 times within 1.5 seconds.
OPAL also includes a child-proof design element to help reduce accidental activation and support safer handling and storage.

What’s in the Box
1 × VEIPUS OPAL Device (Golden)
Note: Pods are sold separately. Use compatible pods only.

Product VEIPUS OPAL Device (Golden)
Battery 1100mAh
Power Options 22W / 26W / 28W
Display Hidden screen (battery level + power wattage)
Dimensions 25 × 24.6 × 73.5 mm
Who the Golden OPAL Is Best For
Daily users who want a reliable battery in a compact device.
Pod switchers who rotate flavours and want quick wattage tuning.
Users who prefer simple controls without complex screens or menus.
Minimal-style buyers who want a premium Golden finish with a clean look.
FAQs
Is this a full kit?
No. This is the device only. Pods are sold separately.

How do I change the wattage?
Press the button to cycle through 22W / 26W / 28W. The hidden screen will show your selected wattage.

How do I turn the device on or off?
Press the button 5 times within 1.5 seconds to toggle power on/off.

Safety & Compliance Notes
KEEP OUT OF REACH OF CHILDREN. Adult use only. Store the device securely, use compatible pods only, and follow all local regulations. If you are new to adjustable power devices, start at 22W and increase gradually to find your preferred comfort level.

description:
VEIPUS OPAL 15K Prefilled Pod – Blueberry Raspberry Bubble Gum (Pod Only)
VEIPUS OPAL Blueberry Raspberry Bubble Gum is a pod-only replacement made to pair with a compatible VEIPUS OPAL device. It’s ideal for customers who like sweet, playful flavours and want a quick replacement pod that stays consistent day after day. Built with a Dual Mesh coil, this pod supports smooth, even delivery, while the visible juice design makes it easy to check remaining liquid at a glance. Add adjustable airflow (small/medium/large), and you get simple control over how tight or open the draw feels—without complicated setup.

Flavour Notes: Berry Candy Meets Bubble Gum
This flavour blends two classic berry tones—blueberry depth and raspberry brightness—then finishes with a soft bubble gum sweetness. The inhale brings a mixed-berry pop, the mid-note feels like a candy coating, and the exhale leaves a gentle gum-like sweetness that lingers without tasting harsh. It’s the kind of profile that works well when you want a sweeter option that still feels smooth and balanced.

Dual Mesh Coil for Cleaner Sweetness
Sweet candy profiles can feel inconsistent on basic coils. The Dual Mesh coil helps keep delivery steady, which typically means the berry notes stay clear and the bubble gum finish remains smooth rather than overly sharp. If you enjoy dessert-leaning flavours but still want a clean finish, this build is designed to help.

Airflow Control: Tune the Candy Intensity
Small airflow: denser, more concentrated candy tone
Medium airflow: balanced sweetness with comfortable draw resistance
Large airflow: lighter feel, smoother overall mouthfeel
For the fullest “bubble gum” effect, many users prefer small. If you want it softer and smoother, move to large.

Visible Juice: Practical for Rotation
If you keep multiple pods—one fruity, one candy, one mint—the visible juice design is genuinely useful. You can quickly check levels before leaving home, which is especially helpful when you rely on one flavour as your main daily option.

Hardware matters for candy flavours, so this pod uses a Dual Mesh coil to support smooth, even heating, a visible juice design for easy level checks, and adjustable airflow so you can tune the draw for a more concentrated or more open feel.

Strawberry Watermelon Hard Candy Flavour Profile
This blend opens with strawberry’s soft, sweet berry note, then layers in watermelon’s juicy freshness. The “hard candy” element rounds everything out with a glossy sweetness that tastes like a fruit lolly rather than a natural fruit drink. The mid-draw feels bright and punchy, while the finish stays sweet with a clean aftertaste that encourages repeat use. If you enjoy dessert-style fruit flavours that lean bold and fun, Strawberry Watermelon Hard Candy delivers a strong candy profile without feeling overly heavy.

Airflow Control: Make It Richer or Lighter
Adjustable airflow helps you shape how the candy sweetness hits:

Small airflow: tighter draw, stronger candy intensity
Medium airflow: balanced sweetness and smoothness
Large airflow: airy draw, lighter feel with a smoother finish
If you want the most “lolly-like” punch, try small. For a relaxed all-day profile, medium is usually the safest starting point.

Dual Mesh Coil + Visible Juice Practicality
The Dual Mesh coil supports stable heating to help keep the strawberry-watermelon candy profile consistent over time. The visible juice design helps you plan replacements—particularly useful if you carry this flavour as your “sweet option” alongside a cooler or more classic pod.
